ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all directors, shareholders, registered agents and UBOs against the UN Consolidated List, Vanuatu domestic sanctions and watchlists administered by the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit, and OFAC SDN and EU/UK consolidated lists where USD clearing, correspondent banking or EU/UK nexus exists; enhanced due diligence required for PEPs, PEP family members and close associates under Part 4 of the AML/CFT Act No. 12 of 2020.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission – Companies Office online name reservation facility (VFSC e-Registry / VUIC Online)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Official languages are English and French; corporate names must be in Latin script only; Bislama names acceptable; non-Latin characters rejected and foreign names must be romanized; the name must end in a required suffix such as Limited, Ltd, Corporation, Corp, Incorporated, Inc, S.A. or SA.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: No statutory extension exists; re-apply after expiry. On rejection, the applicant or licensed agent may file a written reconsideration request to the VFSC Registrar within 14 days under the International Companies Act, then, if refused, seek judicial review before the Vanuatu Supreme Court under the Civil Procedure Rules 2002; a fresh name search and clearance fee applies to any amended name.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted only where the registered office is the physical Port Vila office of a VFSC-licensed registered agent; a standalone virtual mailbox is not a compliant registered office; the International Company may operate 100% remotely with no local employees, premises or commercial substance requirements.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low: approximate 5% per annum probability of an unannounced VFSC inspection for a low-risk trading International Company; AML/CFT on-site supervision of licensed registered agents is normally conducted once per one-to-three-year cycle.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act [Cap. 222] (Vanuatu), as amended, particularly sections 3 (Incorporation), 7 (Memorandum and Articles), 12 (Registered Office), and 18 (First Directors); the Companies Act [Cap. 191] applies to domestic companies only and is not applicable to International Companies.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) — International Companies Registry, Port Vila, Republic of Vanuatu
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association (Constitution) executed by the subscriber and filed with VFSC together with the Application for Incorporation of an International Company (Form IC-1)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital. The International Company may issue shares of no par value at any nominal consideration; no escrow account or capital deposit is required as a condition of incorporation. Share capital may be denominated in any freely convertible currency.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that the subscriber to the Memorandum and Articles hereby subscribes to one fully paid ordinary share of no par value for the initial capital of the Company and agrees to the allotment of such share. RESOLVED that the registered office of the Company shall be situated in Vanuatu at the address provided by the registered agent. RESOLVED that the First Director, as named in the Articles, is appointed to hold office, and the Director is authorized to appoint the first Company Secretary and registered agent. RESOLVED that the opening of a corporate bank account with an internationally recognized bank is approved and the Director is authorized to execute all banking documents.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Engage Approved Registered Agent and Reserve Company Name
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Registered Agent (licensed under the International Companies (Registered Agents) Regulation)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation request via the licensed registered agent to VFSC listing at least three proposed corporate names. The name must contain 'Limited', 'Corporation', or 'Incorporated' or its abbreviations and must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing name in the VFSC index.
required_dossiers: Identity verification of the beneficial owner
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected, file an administrative appeal with VFSC Registry within 5 business days; alternatively, promptly submit an amended name list without incurring additional fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent obtains the Memorandum and Articles of Association from the approved form set or drafts bespoke provisions. The subscriber must execute the documents in the presence of a witness; where execution is remote, notarization must be provided and the agent certifies the subscriber's capacity.
required_dossiers: Consent of initial director and secretary
Proof of subscriber identity and residential address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registrar returns a non-compliance query, the agent has 14 calendar days to resubmit corrected documents; no re-payment of filing fee is required for minor corrections unless the document is deemed substantially new.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: File Statutory Incorporation Application and Pay Government Fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) — International Companies Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent files the executed Memorandum and Articles together with the Application for Incorporation (Form IC-1) electronically through the VFSC portal or in hard copy at the VFSC office in Port Vila. The government filing fee of USD 400 (or equivalent in Vatu) must accompany the application.
required_dossiers: Application for Incorporation of an International Company (Form IC-1)
Agent certificate under the International Companies Act (Registered Agents) Regulation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried for incorrect capital statements or missing endorsements, VFSC will raise a tendering notice. The agent must cure within 21 days; failure results in automatic rejection and a fresh application is required with a refund of one-half fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain Certificate of Incorporation and Lodge Post-Incorporation Records
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC and the registered office in Vanuatu
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, VFSC issues the Certificate of Incorporation naming the Company and its incorporated date. The registered agent registers the minute book, share certificates, and statutory registers at the registered office address. Articles must be reprinted with the certificate date and certificate number endorsed on each page.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of the Memorandum and Articles
First director and secretary consent forms
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate contains an error (e.g., mismatched name or date), the Company may apply for a certificate of correction under the VFSC rectification procedure by filing a statutory declaration and returning the original certificate for correction.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable — the Company conducts cross-border trade and distribution of packaged matcha powder only; no manufacturing, processing, torrefaction, blending, or other industrial activity occurs within the territory of Vanuatu.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not required. The Company, as an International Company, is not permitted to carry on local wholesale business in Vanuatu; therefore no domestic business or industrial license under the Business Licences Act is triggered. If physical storage is later introduced, a Business Licence may be required from the Vanuatu Department of Finance and Treasury.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Vanuatu Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (Vanuatu Environment Unit)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — trading activity is limited to the procurement and cross-border distribution of sealed organic matcha powder; no point-source pollution, no effluent discharge, and no land-use alteration. A Class 2 Environmental Registration would only be required if warehousing or repackaging operations commence.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: N/A — the Company has zero wastewater discharge, zero volatile organic compound (VOC) emissions, and produces no hazardous waste. Imported matcha powder shall be received and forwarded with intact quarantine and phytosanitary certification; any damaged stock or packaging waste must be handled under municipal solid waste disposal rules and not incinerated.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: No industrial fire safety certification or structural inspection is required at formation because the Company operates solely through a serviced office / registered agent address. Upon establishment of any physical office, a general building and fire safety clearance must be obtained from the Vanuatu Fire and Emergency Services and the municipality; office occupancy with fewer than five employees requires no special occupational clearance under the Health and Safety at Work Act.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Department of Customs and Inland Revenue (DCIR), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management, Republic of Vanuatu (portal: https://customsinlandrevenue.gov.vu); International Company regulation and annual supervision by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) (portal: https://www.vfsc.vu).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Vanuatu imposes no income tax, corporation tax, capital gains tax, or withholding tax. An International Company (IC) incorporated under the International Companies Act (Cap 222) is statutorily exempt from all Vanuatu taxes and receives no TIN; its statutory identifier is the VFSC Certificate of Incorporation registration number. An IC engaged purely in offshore procurement and distribution of organic matcha powder is not required to register with the DCIR. If the IC makes taxable supplies inside Vanuatu exceeding VT 10,000,000 per annum, it must apply for VAT registration on DCIR Form VAT-01, submitting the Certificate of Incorporation, certified constitution, registered agent and registered office evidence, director and shareholder KYC details, a valid Vanuatu business licence, and a description of the matcha trading activity; the DCIR then issues a VAT registration number.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None. Vanuatu has no corporate income tax, no check-the-box regime, and no hybrid-mismatch election legislation. The IC's tax-exempt status is automatic upon incorporation and a declaration in its constitution under section 8 of the International Companies Act (Cap 222). The only structural election available is conversion of the IC into a domestic Vanuatu company (with VFSC and Ministerial approval), which terminates the tax-exempt zone status and exposes the entity to VAT, business licensing, customs duties, and general Vanuatu fiscal law.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the Value Added Tax Act (Cap 302), administered by the Department of Customs and Inland Revenue (DCIR); headline rate 15%.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Vatu (VT) 10,000,000 (approx. USD 82,000) aggregate annual value of taxable supplies; persons making taxable supplies in Vanuatu above this threshold must register with the DCIR. A non-resident International Company conducting offshore matcha procurement and distribution with no Vanuatu taxable supplies has no indirect tax nexus and no registration obligation. Voluntary VAT registration is available to a non-resident supplier making zero-rated exports where the Commissioner is satisfied as to business purpose and record-keeping capacity.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: None. Vanuatu does not operate real-time fiscal clearance, API reporting, or digital stamping. Taxpayers must issue sequentially numbered VAT invoices (paper or PDF) showing the VAT ID, date, description, zero-rated or exempt indication, and tax amount, and must retain records for at least five years. Customs declarations are cleared electronically through the ASYCUDA World platform operated by the DCIR; no additional e-invoicing clearance applies.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Under section 7(2) of the VAT Act (Cap 302), 0% VAT applies to (i) goods physically exported from Vanuatu within 28 days of the date of supply (or such extended period as the Commissioner allows); (ii) supplies made in relation to goods for export; and (iii) services physically performed outside Vanuatu or ancillary to international transport. To claim 0%, the supplier must hold proof of export, including the customs export declaration and transport documents, and must issue a VAT invoice bearing a clear zero-rated notation. For the offshore Vanuatu International Company model, where organic matcha powder is procured abroad and re-sold to overseas buyers without the goods entering Vanuatu, no Vanuatu VAT arises at all because the supply occurs wholly outside the indirect tax territory; export zero-rating documentation becomes relevant only if goods are physically shipped from Vanuatu.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (SAD) submitted electronically through the ASYCUDA World customs system to the Vanuatu Department of Customs and Inland Revenue
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical removal of the organic matcha powder from Vanuatu
Commercial Invoice and Packing List matching the customs declaration in description, quantity, and value
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank SWIFT credit evidence confirming receipt of foreign export proceeds
Certificate of Origin, phytosanitary certificate, or organic certification where required by the destination jurisdiction
VAT invoice annotated 'Zero-rated – Export' where the supply is exported from Vanuatu
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Vanuatu has no exchange-control law, so no statutory FX repatriation deadline is imposed; the 180-day period is the standard banking and export-credit convention, and remittance evidence must be preserved for DCIR audits. Fraudulent export zero-rating, false declarations, and baseless VAT refund claims are prosecuted under the VAT Act (Cap 302) and Customs Act (Cap 155): DCIR may reassess and retrospectively claw back refunded VAT, charge statutory interest, impose fines and imprisonment, forfeit goods, cancel VAT registration, and refer offenders for criminal prosecution. For an International Company, misconduct additionally triggers VFSC administrative sanctions, including strike-off and director disqualification, and personal criminal liability of directors under Vanuatu anti-money-laundering statutes.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vanuatu Vatu (VUV) is freely convertible for current account transactions. Vanuatu has eliminated capital controls and maintains no general exchange control restrictions on inward or outward payments of a trade or investment character. Profit remittances by an International Company (VU_IC) are permitted without prior RBV approval, subject only to anti-money-laundering/know-your-customer (AML/KYC) checks, proof of beneficial ownership, and availability of supporting trade documents. Divergent but well-established Treatment: profit distribution to non-resident shareholders is ordinarily unrestricted given the zero-tax regime, but banks may apply enhanced due diligence where the remittance is classified as equity contribution, shareholder loan repayment, or royalty flows. The practical hurdle is effective liquidity for VUV/USD conversion due to the shallow local interbank market and dependence on Australian (AUD) and United States (USD) correspondent clearing; large disbursements will require settlement through offshore USD or AUD nostro accounts. No surrender of exported proceeds is required and no restrictions apply to holding foreign currency in a VU-licensed bank or in an offshore account of a Vanuatu International Company, provided the account is declared for AML purposes.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Not applicable — Vanuatu has no statutory Export Proceeds Surrender Regime. The Exchange Control Act [Cap. 41] does not prescribe a timeline, a minimum conversion ratio, or a mandatory repatriation threshold for export receipts of goods, including culinary and ceremonial grade organic matcha powder. Export earnings may be retained in VUV, USD, AUD, EUR, or JPY in a freely operated trade account. The only compliance requirements are: (1) accurate declaration on the export documentation or commercial invoice to the Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue for statistical/reporting purposes; (2) full traceability of the underlying transaction through the commercial bank for AML/CFT obligations under the Vanuatu AML/CFT Act No. 5 of 2017; and (3) no artificial pricing or transfer pricing misstatement if a related-party Japanese or Chinese matcha supplier is involved. Mandatory conversion ratio: 0%; Surrender timeline: none.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account / Operational Account (VUV and USD)
Operational Account / Trade Settlement Account (VUV, AUD, USD, JPY)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low feasibility for offshore digital EMIs or payment/e-money institutions domiciled outside Vanuatu. Legal constraint: any deposit-taking, electronic-money issuance, payment processing, or money-transfer activity targeting or operated from Vanuatu requires a license from the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu under the Banking Act [Cap. 73] and the Debit/Credit Card and Other Payment Systems Act; non-resident EMIs are not automatically recognized and cannot access local settlement rails. An offshore EMI may be used solely as a front-end collection tool if the underlying settlement is ultimately booked through a RBV-licensed bank with a local bank account. Conversely, a VU_IC attempting to bank with an unregulated foreign EMI will encounter serious friction from corresponding-bank due diligence and will be treated as a higher AML risk for the organic matcha trade because the counterparty jurisdiction (Japan/China) requires bank-to-bank documentary trade trails. Practical recommendation: adopt a hybrid model; use an established, licensed fintech EMI for e-commerce customer collections if the business has retail/ceremonial-grade matcha direct-to-consumer sales, but ensure EUR/USD balances are swept daily to a VU licensed operational account. Risk rating: Medium-to-High legal/regulatory friction; not viable as primary clearing rail.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Mandatory physical presence is effectively required for a newly formed Vanuatu International Company engaging in cross-border commodities trade. RBV-licensed commercial banks under the Vanuatu AML/CFT regime require that at least one director or senior manager (or a duly authorized professional-introducer representative) personally attend the bank's compliance interview in Port Vila or Santo to verify identity and beneficial ownership; video-conference KYC is generally insufficient for the initial account opening, but can supplement. Remote opening is permitted only on a case-by-case basis if the entity already enjoys a banking relationship with an internationally recognized bank, provides certified/notarized identification documents, and appoints the registered agent (licensed under the VFSC) to attest to the corporate register. The company should specifically budget for the board resolution granting the delegated authority to the Vanuatu resident natural person who will execute the documentary compliance package. A clear mandate is: the ultimate beneficial owner and at least one director must be identifiable and must complete the standard source-of-wealth questionnaire; for capital escrow activation, in-person execution of the account mandate is mandatory.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: International Company (IC) status with tax-exempt and non-resident ownership tested by management as a low-substance offshore shell
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide VFSC Certificate of Incorporation and Good Standing; certified Registers of Members and Directors with full beneficial ownership declaration; IRS/VFSC tax-exemption certificate; signed registered-agent consent; audited or reviewed financial statements of the VU_IC; a detailed business plan for the procurement and distribution of organic matcha; a physical office or work-space lease agreement or delegation to a Vanuatu resident corporate services provider; and an economic-substance statement demonstrating active management decisions, invoicing, contract execution, and treasury control in Vanuatu.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border supplier and payments to/from Japan or China flagged as high-volume trade through a newly established entity lacking prior trading history
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Master supply agreement with the Japanese or Chinese organic matcha miller/producer; pro-forma invoices and commercial invoices; certificates of origin; JAS/ECOCERT or USDA-organic certification; phytosanitary certificate; laboratory analysis for heavy metals and radiation; mill Telex Release or original Bills of Lading; pre-shipment inspection report; and an undertaking signed by the bank client confirming that all trade documents will be routed through banking channels (SWIFT MT103, commercial LC, or trusted documentary collection).

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Third-party capital injection or investor payments routed from a non-Vanuatu shareholder without clear source of funds and business nexus
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed equity subscription agreement or shareholder capital contribution deed; investor bank reference and three months' bank statements showing legitimate accumulation of funds; declaration of source of wealth; organizational chart demonstrating shareholder and ultimate beneficial owner linkage; tax clearance certificate or equivalent domicile status from the investor's residence jurisdiction; and an anti-circumvention declaration that no undisclosed third-party control exists.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk perception due to Vanuatu's financial secrecy/historical tax-haven profile triggering enhanced scrutiny in correspondent-bank onboarding
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Comprehensive CRS/EoIR self-certification; confirmation from the Vanuatu International Companies and Trusts Act that the entity is a legitimate trade vehicle; signed OECD/WTO economic-substance and transfer-pricing declaration; evidence of effective management with documented board minutes in Port Vila; all trade contracts identifying goods, quantities, pricing, quantity discounts, and payment terms; and a clean AML/CFT institutional audit report demonstrating compliance with the Vanuatu AML/CFT Act No. 5 of 2017 and VFSC circular expectations.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant protocol for USD capital injection from non-resident shareholder/investor to VU_IC: remitter instructs SWIFT MT103 (for up to USD 1,000,000) or MT202/MT202COV via the investor's financial institution to the VU bank's USD correspondent, using beneficiary SWIFT BIC (e.g., ANZ VUVUPXVZ or BSP VUVUVUVX) and explicit remittance reference: 'EQUITY CONTRIBUTION / SHARE CAPITAL FOR VU_IC ORGANIC MATCHA TRADE', quoting the VU_IC registered agent file number. Accepted narrative purpose code: 'CAPT' (Capital Contribution), 'TREA' (Trade Payment), or the standard ISO 20022 purpose code 'EQUI' if the correspondent bank requires; in Vanuatu, banks primarily rely on the remittance narrative and do not require an RBV import/export license. The funds are initially credited to a capital escrow sub-ledger or segregated inward flows account, blocked until the bank's AML/compliance officer verifies the source-of-funds declaration and the corresponding corporate resolution. All verification documentation (subscription agreement, KYC, constitutional documents, signed board resolution approving capital raising) must be provided before the escrow release into the operational trading account. For payouts to Japanese matcha suppliers, inbound USD is converted to JPY at an onshore VUV rate or via the delivering bank's USD/JPY desk; alternative: maintain a USD-denominated operational account in Vanuatu and settle the supplier invoice via a USD/JPY forward.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound settlement for organic matcha powder import/trade from Japan/China is executed through: (1) SWIFT MT103 direct telegraphic transfer for open-account settled orders, with payment details matching the pro-forma/commercial invoice (Invoice number, Incoterms, itemized product codes, and weight in kilograms), cleared through the bank's USD/AUD/JPY nostro accounts; (2) SWIFT MT700/M720 irrevocable Commercial Letter of Credit, opened by the VU bank at the supplier's bank, allowing the matcha counterparty to draw against shipping, organic certificate, and phytosanitary documents; (3) SWIFT MT707 amendment trail to manage partial shipments and tolerance clauses; and (4) SWIFT MT752/MT754 authorization/confirmation rails for pre-advised documentary collections. For cross-border high volumes, the VU_IC should standardize on USD clearing via correspondent banks in the United States (e.g., BNY Mellon, JPMorgan Chase, Citibank) or AUD clearing via BSP and ANZ Australian corridors to avoid the limited VUV liquidity pool. All payments must embed the consolidated trade reference code (TRC) enabling reconciliation by both the VU trading entity and the Japanese/Chinese export bank to satisfy end-to-end AML and sanctions screening. No access to CLS settlement for VUV; interbank VUV/USD is executed via telephone/electronic dealing and confirmed with MT300/MT503 confirmation messages. For usual low-risk culinary matcha shipments under USD 25,000, fast settlement via MT103 with a full 70-character remittance detail is the recommended rail.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD/VUV OTC preferentially-deliverable outright forwards, tenor up to 12 months, concluded with the VU settlement bank and confirmed under SWIFT MT300, used to fix the procurement cost of Japanese/Chinese matcha inventory
Offshore Non-Deliverable Forwards (USD/VUV NDF) with international banks when the VUV deliverable leg is illiquid or the counterpart bank refuses onshore counterparty credit; net settled in USD
Cross-currency swaps (USD/JPY and VUV/USD) executed solely to match trade and financing cash flows for large organic matcha supply programs, with mandatory underlying trade contract
European vanilla FX plain-vanilla options (USD call/JPY put) to hedge a committed, documented tender or purchase order exposure, allowed only with the bank's market-risk approval
Correspondent bank USD/JPY, EUR/JPY rate-lock arrangements embedded in the Commercial Letter of Credit (MT700) structure, pricing supplier invoices in JPY while receiving USD from end-customers

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Retention Fee (Government License Fee) payment to maintain the Vanuatu International Company in good standing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on the anniversary of the date of incorporation of the International Company
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late fee of VUV 10,000 (approx. USD 83) per month, plus VUV 50,000 (approx. USD 415) reinstatement surcharge; continued non-payment for 12 months triggers administrative strike-off from the VFSC register and dissolution of the company.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Agent Compliance Declaration confirming registered agent, registered office, and directors (submitted electronically via agent)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) through the licensed registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 calendar days after the company's anniversary date of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-declaration blocks issuance of Certificate of Good Standing and corporate bank account compliance; repeated default for 6 months may trigger a VFSC compliance audit and administrative penalty of up to VUV 100,000 (approx. USD 830).

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit required for a Vanuatu International Company unless the company is carrying on business with the general public of Vanuatu, holds a restricted or exempt financial license, or is otherwise directed by the VFSC. For low-risk matcha powder distribution, no mandatory audit.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS for any voluntarily prepared financial statements; Vanuatu has no local GAAP for International Companies and filing of accounts is not legally required.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Annually confirm the company's beneficial ownership register with the registered agent, including any share transfers during the reporting year. A separate declaration updating the UBO register must be submitted to the VFSC within 14 days of any change in ownership. There is no recurring annual UBO filing fee, but the registered agent must maintain the register at the registered office.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 700 – 1,200 depending on the licensed agent in Port Vila
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 0 – 2,500 (voluntary or VFSC-directed) depending on transaction volume and international buying house declarations

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% for an International Company (IC); Vanuatu does not impose corporate income tax on ICs, whether domestic or foreign-source income.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Total statutory exemption from income tax for International Companies under the International Companies Act. Effective tax rate is 0%; no tax holiday or ring-fenced relief is needed. Goods or services supplied inside Vanuatu may nonetheless attract VAT at 12.5%.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: VFSC International Company Annual Return / Annual Renewal; submitted through the licensed Registered Agent using the VFSC Company e-Filing portal. Vanuatu does not issue a separate CIT return for ICs.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual; no quarterly or provisional corporate income tax return obligations.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due on or before the renewal deadline tied to the anniversary of incorporation, as stated in the VFSC renewal notice issued to the registered agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: International Company legal name, registration number, jurisdiction of incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the exact name and registration number as shown in the VFSC International Companies Register; no Vanuatu tax ID is required.
Confirm the physical address maintained by the registered agent; a P.O. Box alone is not sufficient substance evidence.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered agent name and licence number in Vanuatu.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors must ensure the registered agent is licensed by VFSC and remains current.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Current directors, shareholders and ultimate beneficial owner information.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Provide passport-level particulars and residential address for each non-resident individual; the registered agent must complete risk-based KYC/AML review.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration that the IC has not carried on any taxable domestic business in Vanuatu and remains exclusively international.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the matcha-trade IC only procures and distributes outside Vanuatu, confirm no Vanuatu-source deliveries and no VAT registration obligation.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing by the registered agent or company creates late fees and possible monthly surcharges under the VFSC fee schedule. Continued non-compliance can lead to administrative penalty, automatic strike-off from the register, loss of tax-exempt status, and restoration costs before the company may trade or hold bank accounts again.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0%; Vanuatu does not impose dividend withholding tax or any similar distribution tax on International Companies.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Not applicable as a domestic filing step because Vanuatu does not maintain a comprehensive double taxation agreement network for IC dividend relief. If a foreign shareholder needs source-country treaty protection, the registered agent may request a formal VFSC status certificate / residence certificate for submission to the foreign revenue authority; that authority will apply its own domestic treaty rules.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory and no treaty rate applies. Royalties for IP such as matcha brand trademarks and interest on intercompany loans paid by or to a Vanuatu IC are not subject to Vanuatu withholding tax; withholding, if any, is a matter of the payee jurisdiction's domestic law.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Nil — Vanuatu has not enacted a statutory transfer-pricing documentation regime with a VUV-denominated Local File or Master File threshold. For cross-border related-party matcha procurement, the IC should nonetheless maintain arm's-length contract and pricing evidence to support economic substance and avoid constructive dividend recharacterization by foreign tax authorities.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Applicable. Under Vanuatu's Economic Substance Regulations, an IC engaged in distribution and service centre activity — including cross-border procurement and distribution of matcha powder — must demonstrate economic substance in Vanuatu: physical office, local employees, senior management decisions in Vanuatu, adequate operating expenditure, and an annual economic substance return filed through the registered agent.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion / VAT and Customs Fraud
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the IC to understate or conceal customs value of imported organic matcha powder, falsely declaring consignments destined for Vanuatu as exempt international trade, or making local Vanuatu matcha supplies without VAT registration, invoicing and remitting VAT at 12.5%.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Assessment of the full VAT/customs duty evaded, statutory penalties not exceeding 100% of the evaded amount, interest surcharges, seizure and auction of matcha shipments, and freezing of the IC bank accounts.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly caused false declarations become personally jointly and severally liable for restitution. Criminal conviction may result in imprisonment, financial penalty, and courts may pierce the corporate veil to recover assets from personal accounts.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining the VU_IC as a pure mailbox shell with no physical office, no employees, and no management decision-making in Vanuatu while the board remains absent and all matcha trade contracts are concluded by a non-resident tax advisor.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: VFSC rejection of the economic substance return, administrative penalties, deemed loss of International Company exemption, striking-off from the Vanuatu register, and disqualification of the registered agent if the agent certified a false substance filing.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors face civil liability for the IC's outstanding government fees and penalties, director disqualification orders, asset-freezing orders, and travel bans issued by Vanuatu courts in the course of restoring or winding up the struck-off entity.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Routing Swift_TT or wire-transfer proceeds for matcha powder through Vanuatu accounts without confirming beneficial ownership, sanitising third-party payments, omitting sanctions/PEP screening, or failing to file suspicious transaction reports with the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Enforcement action under the Vanuatu AML/CFT Act: compliance orders, civil penalties against the company, revocation of the registered agent arrangement, freezing and confiscation of funds, and criminal prosecution for money laundering.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and compliance officers who knowingly processed illicit trade proceeds can be charged personally with money laundering; conviction carries imprisonment, asset forfeiture, international travel bans, and disqualification from holding company offices in Vanuatu.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Marketing the Vanuatu IC as a universal tax-free structure for matcha sales to Vanuatu end-users, claiming treaty withholding relief without a valid DTA, or issuing exempt-status certificates to foreign banks for the purpose of hiding discoverable economic substance violations.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Treatment as fraud under the Vanuatu Penal Code and the International Companies Act; VFSC may dissolve the IC, order disgorgement of profits, impose civil monetary penalties, and refer directors to the Public Prosecutor.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally liable for damages suffered by aggrieved commercial counterparties and financial institutions. Courts may impose employment/prohibition orders, travel bans, civil restitution, and custodial sentences proportionate to the fraud.
